name: claude-plugin-antigravity
description: Claude Code plugin integrating Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as autonomous subagents

scripts.test:mcp: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const p = spawn('node', ['mcp-server/index.js']); p.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:1,method:'initialize',params:{protocolVersion:'2024-11-05',capabilities:{},clientInfo:{name:'test',version:'1.0'}}})+'\n'); p.stdout.once('data', d => { console.log('MCP OK:', JSON.parse(d.toString()).result.serverInfo.name); p.kill(); process.exit(0); });"
